reviewMethod: Five evenly spaced frames plus opening/closing frame review, visual silhouette review, and browser decoding/playback checks. Subjective design selections, not model benchmark scores.

ephyra.note: Clear contraction and reopening; clean silhouette.
ephyra.derivation: Black matte keyed to alpha; silent VP9, 480px. Opening 0.2s removed; no speed change or generation.

rho.note: Preserves the green tendril and its small leaning gesture.
rho.derivation: Black matte keyed to alpha; silent VP9, 480px. Opening 0.2s removed; no speed change or generation.

bell.note: Gentle compression stays inside the frame; the FLUX bounce clips the bell.
bell.derivation: Black matte keyed to alpha; silent VP9, 480px. Opening 0s removed; no speed change or generation.

nema.note: An expressive turn that preserves the spiral body.
nema.derivation: Black matte keyed to alpha; silent VP9, 480px. Opening 0s removed; no speed change or generation.

lappet.note: A readable folding gesture; less shape change than the Seedance flower-like curl.
lappet.derivation: Black matte keyed to alpha; silent VP9, 480px. Opening 0s removed; no speed change or generation.

turri.note: A visible tail stretch with the inner jelly preserved.
turri.derivation: Black matte keyed to alpha; silent VP9, 480px. Opening 0s removed; no speed change or generation.

velum.note: The translucent disc curls and settles without leaving the frame.
velum.derivation: Black matte keyed to alpha; silent VP9, 480px. Opening 0s removed; no speed change or generation.
